name: New Glenn
best_known_for: Blue Origin's two-stage reusable heavy-lift orbital launcher — BE-4 first stage + cryogenic second
credit: Fleet launcher entry backfilled to wire New Glenn up through /plan's view-in-fleet link. First flight = NG-1 from LC-36 (2025-01-16) successfully delivered the Blue Ring pathfinder to orbit; first-stage landing attempt failed but the vehicle was certified for repeat ops. Distinct from New Shepard (Blue Origin's earlier suborbital crew launcher; lives under crewed-spacecraft).
